hooks.command: top="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && [ -x "$top/.claude/scripts/format-md.sh" ] && common="$(git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" && [ "$common" = "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir 2>/dev/null)" ] && export CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$top"; "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/scripts/format-md.sh"
